title: Summit Status Waiver on Crestline Companion Phone Booking Fees
content:
For holders of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, a status waiver on the phone booking fee follows the holder's current Summit tier in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program:

| Current Summit tier | Status waiver of the raised phone booking fee |
|---|---|
| Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman | 60 percent |
| Summit Gold or Summit Platinum | 30 percent |
| any other tier | none |

**Hypothetical case.** For a Summit Gold holder, a raised fee of 30.00 USD is waived by 30 percent, 9.00 USD; for a Summit Silver holder nothing is waived.
